## Chicago Wedding Day Overview — 2026-09-19

Indoor ceremony and reception, 120 guests, Chicago, USA. The timeline below keeps dinner started by **6:30 PM**, includes **45 minutes for photos**, and leaves room for **vendor setup, family portraits, speeches, cake cutting, and dancing**.

## Wedding Day Timeline for Ceremony + Reception

| Time | Segment | Details |
|---|---|---|
| 12:00 PM - 1:30 PM | Vendor setup buffer | Venue access, catering load-in, floral/decor placement, AV check, seating chart finalization |
| 1:30 PM - 2:15 PM | Couple gets ready | Hair, makeup, dressing, final touch-ups, detail photos |
| 2:15 PM - 2:45 PM | First look + couple portraits | Private moment, couple photos, immediate family prep |
| 2:45 PM - 3:00 PM | Family portraits | Immediate family photos before guests are seated |
| 3:00 PM - 3:25 PM | Ceremony | Processional, vows, ring exchange, recessional |
| 3:25 PM - 3:40 PM | Guest transition | Guests move to cocktail area; couple resets for photos |
| 3:40 PM - 4:25 PM | Couple photo session | **45 minutes** for wedding party and couple portraits |
| 4:25 PM - 5:15 PM | Cocktail hour | Apps, bar service, guest mingling, room flip if needed |
| 5:15 PM - 5:35 PM | Reception open + grand entrance | Couple entrance, welcome, seating transition |
| 5:35 PM - 6:00 PM | Speeches | Best man, maid of honor, parent or couple toast |
| 6:00 PM - 6:25 PM | Dinner service begins | Salad/first course, plated or buffet service starts |
| 6:30 PM | Dinner officially underway | Dinner has begun by the required time |
| 6:50 PM - 7:05 PM | Main course continues | Table service, guest pacing, brief reset for cake |
| 7:05 PM - 7:15 PM | Cake cutting | Short spotlight moment, dessert service cue |
| 7:15 PM - 7:30 PM | Open dancing starts | First dance, parent dances, then open floor |
| 7:30 PM - 9:30 PM | Dancing + social time | Full dance block, late-night snacks if planned, relaxed mingling |
| 9:30 PM - 10:00 PM | Last call + send-off prep | Final songs, cleanup coordination, exit items |
| 10:00 PM - 10:30 PM | Event wrap | Guest departure, vendor breakdown, couple exit |

## Timing Notes for a Smooth Indoor Flow

- **Dinner by 6:30 PM is protected** with speeches placed earlier and the couple photo block kept to exactly 45 minutes.
- **Family portraits are best before the ceremony** so the post-ceremony window stays on track.
- **Vendor setup buffer starts 3.5 hours before the ceremony**, which is comfortable for a 120-guest indoor event in Chicago.
- If the venue requires a room flip, the **cocktail hour can absorb the transition** without delaying dinner.
- The schedule leaves enough breathing room for a polished pace without feeling rushed.
